# Butler v0.0.16

## Change Log

- Fixed menu bar helper launches so `Open Butler` and `New Chat` open the
  normal Dock-visible App instead of inheriting helper-only mode, with stronger
  helper PID ownership checks for packaged macOS installs. (#40)
- Made App turns show an immediate first visible progress row after durable
  acceptance, added first-visible latency metrics, and kept that progress path
  best-effort so progress delivery cannot fail the authoritative turn. (#41)
- Hardened progressive runtime tool execution by separating durable turn
  admission from request timeouts and projecting completion, cancellation, and
  validation outcomes through the App session view. (#42)
- Added Z.AI / GLM hosted provider support, including GLM catalog entries and
  editable OpenAI-compatible API base URLs for registered hosted models. (#43)
- Moved obsolete repo-local Butler App specs out of the release surface now
  that canonical Project Ledger specs govern those areas, reducing stale spec
  drift in release checks. (#44)
